remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, OPPORTUNITY! In the middle of the Gold Coast (Greenwich, New Canaan and Darien). Luxurious Colonial with Smart Design for Modern Living. North Stamford is one of the Safest Areas in the country. Corner of Woodbine Road and Reservoir Lane. A stones' throw from the Laurel Reservoir. Total 7,568 SqFt square feet* Stunning 5,285 sq ft of sophisticated living space plus 2,283 sq.ft. of Walk-out Finished Basement with high ceilings. Dramatic two-story foyer with elegant double curved staircases * Brick front with cedar siding exterior* New roof (5 years old)* 12 spacious rooms with premium hardwood floors * Dedicated in-law/nanny suite with separate entrance on Main Level.* Summer kitchen in basement in Open Space (2,283 square feet) Great for Large Parties!* Five bathrooms with marble finishes *LUXURY COMFORT * Three wood-burning fireplaces/stove *State-of-the-art Hydro-Air Heating and AC  High-end stainless steel appliances (Two Separate Sinks) *SECURITY & CONVENIENCE * Whole house emergency generator * Integrated security system (burglar/fire alarm) * Lightning arrestor system * Epoxy paint applied on Garage Floor. Whole House water filtration system. LED lighting installed throughout for brightness and Energy Efficiency Dusk to Dawn lighting outside.
